content: Man is not made for defeat. A man can be destroyed but not defeated.
author: Ernest Hemingway
story:
Preserved as part of Ernest Hemingway's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of indomitable and resilience. Across his life and work, Ernest Hemingway returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
